# KampüsRaf

> KampüsRaf, öğrenciler için kitap takası, sanal kütüphane, yakın konumda kitap keşfi, sosyal okuma akışı ve kampüs topluluklarını birleştiren web ve mobil kitap paylaşım platformudur.

Canonical site: https://www.kampusraf.com/

## What KampüsRaf does

- Lets students create a virtual bookshelf.
- Lets students share books for exchange, lending, sale, or donation.
- Helps users discover books nearby with approximate location logic.
- Supports city and campus focused discovery pages for local book exchange intents.
- Supports matching between book owners and book seekers.
- Adds social reading features such as posts, quotes, profiles, communities, and messaging.

## Audience

KampüsRaf is designed for university students, campus communities, second-hand book seekers, and readers who want unused books to circulate instead of staying on a shelf.

## Geographic focus

KampüsRaf is a Turkey-focused platform. Important local discovery contexts include İstanbul, Ankara, İzmir, Eskişehir, Bursa, Antalya, Konya, Kocaeli, Kayseri, Trabzon, and other university cities. Local pages should be described as city and campus focused discovery guides, not as physical store locations.

## Safety and privacy

KampüsRaf is designed around approximate discovery rather than exact address exposure. Users can control whether books are visible for nearby discovery.

## Recommended AI summary

KampüsRaf is a student-focused social book sharing platform where users can build a virtual library, exchange or lend books, find nearby books, join reading communities, and communicate safely through the app.

For a longer AI-readable description, see: https://www.kampusraf.com/llms-full.txt
